metadata.title: [Bugfix][SM70][DeepSeek-V4.1] Refill the packed-KV hot ring on a session-prefix hit (#1341)
metadata.body:
Contributed by PLI Labs (Proprietary Legal Intelligence). Written with AI assistance (Claude Code).

Fixes #1341. The bug report and the fix are `squibloads`'s (the diff in #1341); this PR ports that fix onto `main`, adds tests, and registers the two variables with metadata. Independent of our other PRs; applies to `main` alone (TP only).

## Purpose

With `VLLM_V41_SESSION_PREFIX=1`, a request that continues the last executed sequence takes a prefix hit at `cached`, and `restore_prefix` rewinds the Engram hash state and the ratio-2 compressor states. It does not rewind the packed-KV hot ring. The previous request wrote compressed rows past `cached` (its answer and up to 4 rejected drafts). Once the context is past `VLLM_V41_KV_HOT_POSITIONS`, the ring has wrapped and those rows sit in the slots of rows about `hot_rows` back, which `fill_selected` and `stage` read as current.

- `kv_store.py`: `V41PackedKV.refill_hot(cached)` rewrites the hot slots of the rows before the hit from the host copy (rank 0 writes every row). Returns the number of rows copied.
- `model.py`: `restore_prefix` calls it when `VLLM_V41_HOT_REFILL=1` and logs the first refill once.
- `kv_cache_manager.py`: the session-prefix reach comes from `VLLM_V41_RING_REACH` (default 124; it was a fixed 128). With 5 draft tokens, rejected drafts reach `processed + 4` and overwrite the 256-row window-ring slots of `P - 128 .. P - 125`.

**Defaults.** This is a correctness fix, so both variables default to the fixed behaviour, as in #1341: `VLLM_V41_HOT_REFILL=1` (set `0` for the old behaviour) and `VLLM_V41_RING_REACH=124` (set `128` for the old reach). Nothing changes unless the session prefix and the packed KV are on.

## Test Plan

```bash
ruff check / ruff format --check   # ruff 0.14.0, changed .py files
python -m tools.generate_env_reference --check
python -m tools.config_inventory --check
python tools/pre_commit/check_env_metadata.py
python tools/pre_commit/check_env_registration.py
python -m tools.generate_architecture_reference --check
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= pytest -q tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_hot_refill.py \
  tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_runner_state.py tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_contract.py
# red first: the new test file against unmodified main
```

`test_deepseek_v41_hot_refill.py` builds a store after a request of prompt + answer + 4 rejected drafts, marks the rows past the hit, and checks the reader invariant: after `refill_hot(cached)`, every slot a reader can take as current (`(newest - hot_rows, newest]`) holds the host row it stands for, at the #1341 prompt length (39,560) and at 37K / 40K / 250K / 500K and small rings. A control shows the check fails without the refill; below the ring no slot changes. `restore_prefix` is checked with the switch unset, `1` and `0`, and without a packed store.

## Path coverage

| Path / provider | Format | Key conditions (shape, TP/EP, graph, capability) | Expected selection / fallback | Evidence (source / static / executed / measured) | Unverified scope |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Session hit, packed KV | DeepSeek-V4.1 | `VLLM_V41_SESSION_PREFIX=1`, `VLLM_V41_PACKED_KV=1`, context past the hot ring | hot slots refilled from the host copy | CPU tests (reader invariant, control); the #1341 probe as reported there | not re-run end to end on GPUs for this PR |
| Session hit, below the ring | same | context under `VLLM_V41_KV_HOT_POSITIONS` | no slot changes | CPU test | — |
| Session prefix reach | same | hit 125-128 behind `processed` | not admitted (reach 124) | CPU test of the default | — |
| Session prefix off / paged KV | all | default | unchanged | CPU tests of the touched files | — |

## Acceleration and benchmark contract (required for performance changes)

Not a performance change. `refill_hot` copies at most `hot_rows` rows per KV source layer, once per session hit.

- New/changed environment metadata and generated reference check: two `configuration` variables registered with metadata; env, config-inventory and architecture references pass.
- SM70 registered variables / unregistered reads / model-parameter restrictions, before -> after: +2 registered, 0 unregistered reads.

## Test Result

**Reported in #1341** by its author (4x V100-SXM2-32GB, TP4, DSpark 5): the A/B probe there (session hit after a 64-token answer vs after a 1-token answer, greedy, logprobs) differs from the first token at ~40K on `main` and is identical with the fix; 20K / 36K / 45K / 60K identical; cold runs at 8K / 32K / 128K still bit-identical. We did not re-measure this for the PR.

**Re-run for this PR, 2026-11-05,** CPU only (no visible GPU), on `main` `3c051b52e`:

- `test_deepseek_v41_hot_refill.py`: 14 passed. Red first: the same file on unmodified `main`: 11 failed, 3 passed (the passing three are the no-refill control, the `HOT_REFILL=0` case and the no-store case).
- `test_deepseek_v41_runner_state.py`, `test_deepseek_v41_contract.py`: pass (7 CUDA-only cases skipped).
- `generate_env_reference --check`, `config_inventory --check`, `check_env_metadata.py`, `check_env_registration.py`, `generate_architecture_reference --check`: all pass.
- ruff 0.14.0 `check` and `format --check` on the 5 changed Python files: pass.

Not re-run: any GPU test or serving.

---
